lessons_used: Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted impact, while zero or negative forecasts sometimes preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-15.7% and -8.9%).
Adding new flows during adoption (adoption, new_flow) consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 3 tests (-13.3%, -0.9%, and -4.5%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both agreeing tests (+0.9% and +1.9%).
Waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) mostly showed no clear effect across 8 of 12 tests, despite 3 winning tests (+6.4%, +3.6%, and +2.7%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) produced inconsistent results, ranging from strong wins to severe losses.

candidates.title: Choose Path Split Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose path step using a split view layout that presents ready companions versus custom photo pet paths side-by-side.
candidates.why: Choose path has a high mean duration of 514s, indicating users struggle to evaluate the difference between ready pets and photo generation.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Pet Path
choose_path.body: Choose between ready companion pets or create your own custom pet from photos.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of choose path screen preserving both path options.

candidates.score_note: Choose path has low drop-off, but choose_path redesign consistently wins (+1.7% across 7 tests).

candidates.title: Sign In Later In Journey Reorder
candidates.change: Reorder the onboarding flow so sign-in occurs after pet adoption certificate confirmation, right before generation waiting.
candidates.why: Moving sign-in after pet adoption lets users bond with their pet selection first while ensuring cloud account saving occurs right before generation.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed and preserves all steps.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in has limited data (+0.8% in 1 test) and requires flow logic changes.

candidates.title: Pet Path Preference Intro Screen
candidates.change: Add a new introductory preview screen before path selection that introduces the two adoption paths with visual card highlights.
candidates.why: Mean time on choose_path is over 8 minutes (514s); a dedicated visual intro screen clarifies options before making a selection.

new_path_intro.headline: Choose How You Want to Adopt
new_path_intro.body: Pick an instant companion pet or design a unique custom pet from your own photos.

guard.reason: Adding a new introductory preview screen within onboarding is allowed and preserves all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens consistently harms conversion performance across past tests.

candidates.title: Sign In Checklist Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen to a checklist layout detailing account cloud sync, pet recovery protection, and multi-device access.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after re-signing in; highlighting account sync benefits directly on sign-in builds trust.

sign_in.headline: Sync & Protect Your Pet
sign_in.body: Sign in to save your pet companion to the cloud and restore it anytime on any device.

guard.reason: Redesigning sign-in layout preserves its core functionality and compliance rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails, but sign_in redesigns historically lose conversion (-0.9%).

candidates.title: Sign In Saved Companion Recovery Hint
candidates.change: Add a prominent sync hint on the sign-in screen explaining that existing pets are automatically linked and recovered via your primary sign-in email.
candidates.why: Top support issue (8 emails) is pets going missing or resetting after signing in with a different account.

sign_in.hint: Signing in with your primary email restores your previously adopted pets instantly.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Choose Path Instant Adoption Headline
candidates.change: Update the headline and body text on choose_path to emphasize instant adoption readiness vs custom photo generation.
candidates.why: The mean time on choose_path is 514s; clear headline distinctions help users decide quickly.

choose_path.headline: Adopt Ready Companion or Create Custom Pet
choose_path.body: Select a ready-to-play companion for immediate launch, or upload photos to generate a unique desktop pet.

guard.reason: Copy update clearly presents both adoption options without violating pricing or fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy update, but choose_path copy changes averaged -1.0% in past tests.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Two Column Grid Layout
candidates.change: Change the layout of pick_friend screen to a structured two-column layout with clear companion pet previews.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 78.8% with median time 89s; organizing choices into side-by-side comparison helps users pick faster.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Friend
pick_friend.body: Select the companion pet that best matches your desk style.

guard.reason: Two-column grid layout redesign preserves the core job of choosing a friend pet.

candidates.score_note: Adoption stage loses 21.2% of users; two-column comparison layout can reduce decision time.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Launch Notification Visual
candidates.change: Update the waiting screen to include a progress component and notification hint to inform users when desktop docking is complete.
candidates.why: Home step median time is 201s with 90.3% completion; users wait long for desktop rendering and 3 support emails reported pet not displaying on desktop.

waiting.hint: Your pet is preparing for your desktop. You will be notified as soon as it is ready to dock.

guard.reason: Updating waiting screen with progress indicator and notification hint is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Both support emails and wait time point to this issue; wait_info changes average +1.4% across 12 tests.

candidates.title: Home Intro Checklist Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro with a checklist layout outlining key controls (drag, hide, interact) for the new desktop pet.
candidates.why: 3 support emails asked how to control, hide, or talk to the pet post-onboarding, and finish step conversion drops to 75.5%.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready on Desktop
home_intro.body: Use the tray menu or click your pet to interact, hide, or open companion controls.

guard.reason: Redesigning home_intro overlay with a checklist layout is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has the highest drop-off (24.5%) and support emails confirm control confusion; finish redesign averages +0.8%.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Spotlight Layout
candidates.change: Update adoption_certificate screen layout to spotlight view highlighting official pet companion adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 78.8%; spotlighting the adoption certificate creates a clear milestone completion moment.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your companion pet is officially adopted and ready for setup.

guard.reason: Spotlight layout redesign of adoption certificate retains official adoption presentation.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has high drop-off (21.2%); spotlighting the certificate creates a clear progress milestone.

lessons_next: Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted impact, while zero or negative forecasts sometimes preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across both agreeing tests (-15.6% and -8.9%).
Adding new flows during adoption (adoption, new_flow) consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across all 3 tests (-13.2%, -0.9%, and -4.5%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both agreeing tests (+0.9% and +1.9%).
Waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) mostly showed no clear effect across 10 of 13 tests, despite 3 winning tests (+6.4%, +3.6%, and +2.7%).
Kinds of changes with only 1 test provide weak evidence and cannot be treated as established patterns until replicated.
